title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 current SGA working record: SGA 6 complete through source page 702
description:
Working SGA translation and source-checking record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects existing public SGA translations and the current source-checked SGA 5/6/7 working streams.

Status at a glance. [##########] SGA 5 source-checked stream: complete through page 484; [##########] SGA 6 strict stream: complete through the original source scan, including the terminological index and index of notations at source pages 693-702; [###-------] SGA 7-I working stream: partial English draft through Expose IX section 6.6.

Latest update. The SGA 6 cumulative French and English readers now run through source page 702, completing the original SGA 6 scan through the indexes. The final index segment is also available as separate English/French readers with a source-scan witness.
notes: Latest update replaces the earlier SGA 6 source-page-669 cumulative readers with complete source-page-702 readers and adds the final terminological/notation index segment as separate checked readers.
